title: Derivative bound for interval smoothing
statement: Let $\eta>0$, let $c\ge0$, and let $\psi\colon\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ be $c$-Lipschitz. For every $x\in\mathbb R$, the interval smoothing $S_\eta\psi$ satisfies $\left|(S_\eta\psi)'(x)\right|\le c$.
replaced: For $\eta>0$ and a real function $\psi$, write $S_\eta\psi(x)=\eta^{-1}\int_0^\eta\psi(x+t)\,dt$. If $\psi$ is $c$-Lipschitz for $c\ge0$, then $|(S_\eta\psi)\prime(x)|\le c$ for every real $x$.
